name: edge-blocked-bots
description: Clean site whose robots.txt permits every crawler, but whose edge refuses the published AI crawler user agents with 403. The defect is invisible to any audit that only reads robots.txt.

expected.notes: robots.txt is clean-site's, which allows everyone, so every cr.robots.* check passes: this is exactly the case a robots.txt-only checker reports as healthy. Both citation-tier agents probed (OAI-SearchBot/index, Claude-User/live_answer) are refused, so cr.access.edge_block is critical. cr.access.edge_block_training passes because a citation-tier block outranks the training-only note. The audit's own user agent is served normally, so every other check matches clean-site.
